assets.name: main.pdf

body:
RoboForge v1.0.0: a controlled comparison of behavior cloning and diffusion action policies on simulated 3D robotic manipulation (robosuite Lift and Can in MuJoCo, robomimic proficient-human demonstrations). Author: Zackary Holt.

**Report:** `main.pdf` is attached (23 pages, a local build, not peer reviewed). SHA-256 `c648e7532e7112cd8bcb3b4e0f118342d6eb97dffd94d3bd1e5448c81b50939f`. Every number in it is generated from the frozen result files.

**Observatory:** https://zackholt05-tech.github.io/roboforge/ is an interactive 3D replay of recorded evaluation episodes and of real denoising steps from the diffusion sampler.

**Findings:** see the generated block in `README.md` (from the same frozen macros as the report). All three studies (Level 1, RGB, Level 2 point clouds) were run once under protocols frozen and committed before their held-out starts were used.

**Read with the findings:** simulation only. Level 1 uses exact simulator state, which is privileged information. The Can diffusion vs BC-MLP separation depends on the interval method. H2-c is not separated. The diffusion action bound is a possible confound (KI-052). Linux x86_64 is unverified (KI-061). The full list is in `docs/FINAL_RELEASE_AUDIT.md` §9 and in the report.

**Reproduce:** `docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md`. The release audit (fresh-clone reproduction, test matrix, scans, publication record) is in `docs/FINAL_RELEASE_AUDIT.md`.
